# momenta

> 101 isometric line figures for the moments every app has. SVG, zero dependencies, ESM. A function per figure and a React component per figure. Every figure takes the same five options, and `state` is the one that matters.

## Install

npm i momenta

## Use

React: `import { Upload } from "momenta/react"` then `<Upload state="loading" />`. Each component renders a `<div>`, forwards its ref, and accepts any `<div>` attribute.

Vanilla: `import { upload } from "momenta"` then `const figure = upload(element, { state: "loading" })`; `figure.update({ state: "success" })`; `figure.destroy()`. In `update`, a key set to `undefined` returns to its default; a key left out keeps its value.

Server: `import { renderToString, styles, upload } from "momenta"` returns the markup of one settled frame. Put `styles` on the page once.

A figure fills its element's width at a 5:4 aspect ratio. As an empty state it works at 160–240px wide, above a heading and one action.

## Options

- `state` ("idle" | "loading" | "success" | "error" | "empty", default "idle"): what the figure shows. "loading" loops; every other state comes to rest.
- `intensity` (number 0…1, default 0.5): how strongly the figure answers the pointer.
- `theme` ("auto" | "light" | "dark", default "auto"): "auto" follows an ancestor with class `dark` or `data-theme="dark"`, then the system.
- `label` (string): the accessible name. Defaults to a description of the figure.
- `play` (boolean, default false): walks through every state on its own until the pointer arrives.
- `progress` (number 0…1): real progress during "loading" instead of a loop. Supported by Upload, Download, Table, Folder, Send, Inbox, Cart, Wallet, Shipping, Write, Imagine, Code, Session.
- `count` (number): items the figure holds. Table rows 1–8, Inbox cards 0–6, Alerts cards 0–4, Team seats 2–8, Cart items 1–5, Wallet coins 1–10, Code digits 4–8, Analytics bars 3–10, Deploy layers 2–6.
- `speed` (number 0…4, default 1): animation speed.
- `colors` ({ plate, hi, edge, mid, lo, ok, err }): colours for this figure only.
- `stroke` (number, default 1): stroke width in CSS pixels.
- `marks` (boolean, default true): the tick on success and the cross on error.
- `interactive` (boolean, default true): answer the pointer.

## Figures (101)

Creators: Discover, Match, Audience, Engagement, Audit, Outreach, Approval, Tracking, Payout, Roi.
Media: Play, Clap, Waveform, Gallery, Vinyl, Rating, Like, Thread, Live.
Security: Lock, Shield, Key, Vault, Fingerprint, Firewall, Handshake, Radar, Compliance, Password.
Productivity: Kanban, Todo, Planner, Timer, Sign, Notes, Archive, Pack, Pin, Whiteboard, Milestone.
Devices: Pair, Battery, Speaker, Watch, Camera, Mic, Printer, Rack, Satellite, Sync, Chip, Cursor.
Wellness: Mood, SleepMoon, Streak, Breathe, Hydrate, Pulse, Sunrise, Rest, Badge, Journal.
Travel: Flight, Locate, Keycard, Luggage, Passport, Globe, Train, Compass, Boarding.

All shelves:

Files: Upload (uploads), Download (downloads, exports), Table (CSV imports), Folder (projects, empty folders), Database (saving, storage).
Communication: Send (sent messages, invites), Inbox (inboxes, queues), Chat (chat, comments, support), Alerts (notifications), Team (members, sharing).
Commerce: Pay (checkout), Cart (carts, orders), Shipping (tracking), Receipt (invoices), Plans (pricing, upgrades), Wallet (balances, payouts).
Account: Code (two-factor), SignIn (sign in, sign up), Denied (permissions, paywalls), Session (timeouts, scheduling), Profile (onboarding).
AI and data: Write (AI replies), Imagine (image generation), Analytics (dashboards), Search (search, no results), Calendar (booking).
System: Connection (offline), NotFound (404), Deploy (deploys, builds), Connect (integrations).

## Theme

Custom properties, set on the figure or any ancestor: `--momenta-plate` (the colour the figure sits on; plates are filled with it to hide what is behind), `--momenta-hi`, `--momenta-edge`, `--momenta-mid`, `--momenta-lo`, `--momenta-ok`, `--momenta-err`, `--momenta-stroke` (stroke width in CSS pixels).

## Make your own

`defineFigure({ name, label, setup, draw })`. See docs/ANATOMY.md and the momenta-create skill in skills/.
